name: CatalystDesk Market Regime
description: Inspect descriptive market regime, liquidity, and cross-frame statistics for curated tickers.

auth.paid_tools: Prepaid bearer sessions and x402 are supported by the gateway when the client can supply payment headers.

compliance_notes: This connector sends no key or payment headers, so its calls receive the synthetic fallback. To compute on your own Polygon / Massive data, use an MCP client that sends X-Polygon-Api-Key or a prepaid bearer, such as the stdio bridge with --save-polygon-key-stdin.

Missing, invalid, or ineligible Polygon keys get 15-minute delayed synthetic fallback at zero charge; throttled keys receive 429 polygon_rate_limited on paid tools at zero charge. See /go/polygon for subscription plans.
Descriptive market regime analytics only. No investment advice, trade recommendations, or order placement.
Tool responses set executable to false and redistribution_allowed to false.

Paid analytics use your real-time or 15-minute delayed Polygon / Massive key. Missing, invalid, or ineligible keys receive clearly labeled synthetic context at zero charge; throttled keys receive 429 polygon_rate_limited on paid tools at zero charge.
